title: The number comes back
lines: You run a study’s code and get the same result, but does its conclusion follow?
Executable Scientific Intelligence proposes scientific papers whose claims can be checked through linked data and code.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Distinguish repeated computation from justified interpretation. Name the book and its research problem.
voiceDirections: Conversational and immediately clear; give light emphasis to “same result / conclusion follow”. Sound interested in the question, not as if revealing a secret.
